name: The Student
description: Three years of studying for a fair shot at a government job, now caught between the movement and the risk of losing everything.

name: The Journalist
description: Chasing the story as it unfolds, weighing the pull of getting closer against the cost of staying safe.

name: The Rickshaw-Puller
description: Every blockade and curfew is a missed fare. Survival and the movement don't always pull in the same direction.
